As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Merges partial reports from multiple agents into a unified packet for human review. Scores acceptance criteria based on test results, ranks findings and decisions, and ensures the rapporteur cannot omit collected data—enforced by restore_packet restoring anything omitted by order_packet.
